Research

Long-term questions around communities, self-organization, and how spaces mediate collective life.

Themes

This page is a place to collect and refine research themes over time: how communities form and sustain themselves, how different kinds of co-living and alternative spaces emerge, and how they might be documented and understood.

Questions

You can use this section to gather the questions that return across projects and writing — the ones that do not belong to a single piece of work, but to a longer inquiry.
